config_py.description: Path to the primary Python configuration file for qutebrowser.

basedir.description: Base directory for all storage. Defaults to home directory, but qutebrowser uses ~/.config/qutebrowser internally unless --basedir is overridden in environment or specific paths are set.

qt_wrapper.description: The Qt wrapper to use. Either 'PyQt5' or 'PyQt6'.

backend.description: The browser backend to use. Either 'webkit' or 'webengine'.

desktop_file_name.description: The base name of the desktop entry, used for app_id under Wayland.

loglevel.description: Console log level. One of: critical, error, warning, info, debug, vdebug.

logfilter.description: Comma-separated list of log categories to filter for stdout debugging.

loglines.description: Number of debug log lines to keep in RAM. -1 for unlimited.

json_logging.description: Output log lines in JSON format.

nowindow.description: Don't show the main window (headless mode).

qt_args.description: List of arguments to pass to Qt via --qt-arg NAME VALUE.

qt_flags.description: List of Qt flags to pass via --qt-flag.

debug_flags.description: List of debugging feature names to enable via --debug-flag.

startup_urls.description: List of URLs to open on startup.

startup_commands.description: List of qutebrowser commands to execute on startup.

restore_session.description: Name of the session to restore.

open_target.description: How URLs should be opened if instance exists. auto, tab, tab-bg, tab-silent, tab-bg-silent, window, private-window.
